selected_source_excerpts.dynamical_principle: Apart from the vacuum selections of Section~\ref{sec:siegel} --- the one-loop minimum at the forty Witting rays (trinification) and the soft-supertrace choice of the $\log\tfrac85$ Clifford orbit, both computed for an assumed field content rather than derived from $\W$ --- every result in this paper is kinematics. What action, Hamiltonian or spectral principle on $\W$ has the structures found here as its symmetries, and what does it predict? In particular: does such a principle select the clock real form $E_{8(-24)}$ over the split form --- does the geometry \emph{choose} one time? Theorem~7.3 answers the second question at the level of a selection rule. The clock form is anchored at an event and the split form at a tensor factorisation. The elementary tick (a symplectic transvection) is compatible only with the clock form, at its centre.

novelty_corrections: Pass 12055's L2 statement is numerical in its own original script; new tick majorization certificate proves it for all p>=1 at T>0.
The 90 size-4 and 2880 size-7 noncollinear packets were prior corpus (BT819 and Passes 5904-5919, 7269-7276); only the interaction application is newly certified.
